extensionDescription.message: AI-powered instant speech translation for all video meetings. Break language barriers with real-time voice translation.

clickToStart.message: Click "Open GM MeetMind" below to start real-time translation.

quickStartInstructions.message: Configure your API key (OpenAI or Gemini) → Select "Sokuji_Virtual_Mic" as microphone → Start speaking!

gatherTownGuidance.message: Kutumia GM MeetMind, chagua "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" katika mipangilio ya kipaza sauti chako.

wherebyGuidance.message: Kutumia GM MeetMind, tafadhali chagua "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" katika mipangilio ya kipaza sauti chako na lemaza kupunguza kelele kwa utendaji bora zaidi.

defaultGuidance.message: To use GM MeetMind, please select "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings.

discordGuidance.message: To use GM MeetMind, please select "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings and disable Noise Suppression in Discord's Voice settings for better performance.

slackGuidance.message: To use GM MeetMind in Slack Huddles, please start a Huddle, then select "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" in your Video and Mic settings, and disable Noise Suppression in Audio & Video preferences for better performance.

teamsTitle.message: GM MeetMind kwa ajili ya Microsoft Teams

teamsGuidance.message:
Ikiwa huoni orodha kamili ya vifaa vya sauti katika mipangilio ya Teams:
1) Zima kwa muda ugani wa GM MeetMind na onyesha upya ukurasa
2) Ruhusu Teams kufikia maikrofoni na kamera yako unapoombwa
3) Washa tena ugani wa GM MeetMind na onyesha upya ukurasa tena
4) Ruhusu GM MeetMind kufikia maikrofoni yako unapoombwa. Sasa unapaswa kuona vifaa halisi na "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" katika mipangilio yako.

jitsiGuidance.message: Ili kutumia GM MeetMind katika Jitsi Meet, fungua Settings > Devices na uchague "GM MeetMind Virtual Microphone" kama maikrofoni yako. Kisha fungua Advanced audio settings na uzime Noise suppression, Echo cancellation, na Automatic gain control kwa sauti ya tafsiri iliyo wazi.

desktopCtaBody.message: Maikrofoni wa kawaida wa mfumo mzima kwa OBS, YouTube, Twitch na programu yoyote ya desktop. Windows · macOS · Linux.

browserSitesHeading.message: Unapenda kivinjari? GM MeetMind inafanya kazi kwenye tovuti hizi — bofya kufungua:

detectFailBody.message: Onyesha upya ukurasa na ufungue GM MeetMind tena.
